for an unknown field; 403 `fresh_auth_required` for a stale session without the password; a wrong or throttled
password, or one that is no string, the login failure body without Retry-After. The body is checked before fresh
auth.

200.description: The token and its plaintext, shown once

400.description: A malformed field (invalid_name, invalid_expiry, invalid_kind, invalid_roles, invalid_profile, invalid_scope) or a refused one

401.description: No session, or the inline password or code failed (the login failure body)

403.description: fresh_auth_required, session_required, impersonating, or action_refused (with `code`) when an `authn.token.create` hook refuses

reauthPassword.description: the account password, when the session is not fresh

delete.description:
The token stops working on its next request. 404 `token_not_found` for any id that is not a live token of the
caller, whoever owns it; 403 `action_refused` with the hook's code when an `authn.token.revoke` hook refuses.

**Policies applied:**

- [`NoImpersonationPolicy`](#policy-noimpersonationpolicy)

patch.description:
Body `{ name?, roles?, expiresAt? }`. Only narrows: roles must be a subset of the token's (or of the owner's, for a token
without roles) and expiresAt not later than the current one. No fresh auth. 400 `invalid_name`, `invalid_roles`,
`invalid_expiry`, `invalid_scope` or `invalid_field` (any other key, before the others); 404 `token_not_found`; 403
`action_refused` with `code` when an `authn.token.update` hook refuses.

**Policies applied:**

- [`NoImpersonationPolicy`](#policy-noimpersonationpolicy)

400.description: invalid_name, invalid_roles, invalid_expiry, invalid_scope or invalid_field

post.description:
Replaces the secret of a live token; the id, name, roles and expiry stay. Needs fresh auth like the create route.
Body `{ graceSeconds?, reauthPassword? }`: the old secret works for `graceSeconds` more (0 to 604800, default 0).
Answers `{ Token, Plaintext }`; the new plaintext is shown here once. 400 `invalid_grace` or `invalid_field`; 404
`token_not_found` for any id that is not a live token of the caller; 403 `action_refused` with `code` when an
`authn.token.rotate` hook refuses.

- [`NoTokenAuthPolicy`](#policy-notokenauthpolicy)

post.description:
Mails a single-use link to the address of the session's account. 202 `{ Ok: true }` whether or not a mail goes out
(an address already verified gets none); 429 with Retry-After when throttled. A session only: 403
`session_required` for a token or key, 403 `impersonating` while impersonating.

- [`NoTokenAuthPolicy`](#policy-notokenauthpolicy)
- [`NoImpersonationPolicy`](#policy-noimpersonationpolicy)
